set.body: Bounded slice of S2.9: wire File New/Open/Close against the existing project-session and platform ports. Create/open a real project, show untitled/named title and dirty state correctly, handle cancelled chooser and refused/cancelled open safely, and request close admission for unsaved edits or an active run. Keep project resources/listeners owned and close them once. Focused ProjectLifecycleFxSuite and pure transition tests; real reopen acceptance. Excludes Save As, Open Recent/concurrent preferences and the remaining broad portability audit; S2.9 parent remains open until those separate slices finish. No scientific computation, document/schema/protocol expansion or public library changes. Follow AGENTS checkout ownership and one combined landing gate.
set.title: S2.9a Project lifecycle: New, Open and Close with safe close admission
